name: Document Converter
description: Convert Excel to Word, Word to Excel, Word to PDF and PDF to Word
help: Choose a direction, then add or drop files. Several files are converted in one go; the new files are saved next to the originals (or in the folder you choose) and nothing is overwritten.

Excel → Word and Word → Excel run inside ToolForge. Each worksheet becomes a heading and a table in Word; each table in a Word document becomes a worksheet in Excel. A Word document without tables is copied paragraph by paragraph into one column.

Word → PDF and PDF → Word use LibreOffice, which keeps the layout of the document. Install the free LibreOffice to use them; ToolForge finds it automatically and runs it in the background without opening a window. Old .doc, .rtf and .odt files are also read through LibreOffice.
PDF → Word works best for PDFs made from text documents; scanned pages stay images, so run them through the OCR tool first.
Numbers in Word tables become real numbers in Excel; codes with leading zeros such as 007 and long ID numbers stay text.

excelToWord.name: Excel to Word
excelToWord.engine: Runs in ToolForge; LibreOffice is not needed.
excelToWord.hint: Each non-empty worksheet becomes a table; wide sheets use landscape pages.

wordToExcel.name: Word to Excel
wordToExcel.engine: Runs in ToolForge for .docx; .doc, .rtf and .odt need LibreOffice.
wordToExcel.hint: Each table becomes a worksheet. Documents without tables are copied paragraph by paragraph.

wordToPdf.name: Word to PDF
wordToPdf.engine: Uses LibreOffice to keep the layout.
wordToPdf.hint: Fonts that are not installed on this computer are replaced with similar ones.

pdfToWord.name: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.engine: Uses LibreOffice to rebuild an editable document.
pdfToWord.hint: The layout is rebuilt with text boxes, so editing works best for simple pages. Works best with text PDFs; scanned pages stay as images.
